title: WinBrew CLI JSON output envelope v1
description: With --json, stdout carries exactly ONE JSON document following this schema (A8). Versioned separately from the manifest schema. Progress/decoration never appear on stdout with --json.

command.description: The invoked command, e.g. 'list', 'config get', 'repo add'.

warnings.description: Non-fatal notices (e.g. x86 fallback, expired metadata served offline).

code.description: Exit code per D9 (WinBrew.Cli/ExitCodes.cs is the single mapping).
